issue_body: We added a helper tbx.Commafy(n int) string that should format an integer with comma thousands separators: 0 -> "0", 42 -> "42", 1000 -> "1,000", 1234567 -> "1,234,567" (digits grouped in threes from the right). The grouping lands in the wrong place for some values: 1234 comes out as "123,4" and 1234567 as "123,456,7" instead of "1,234" and "1,234,567". Please make tbx.Commafy produce correctly grouped output.

expected_behavior: tbx.Commafy groups digits in threes counted from the right for any magnitude.
